answer: Make every key prove it is a separate mind at the same instant. At an unannounced beacon moment, each agent gets its own puzzle needing a few seconds of real inference and must reply within 20 seconds. A farmer with a thousand keys must forge a thousand answers at once, keeping a thousand-fold burst of compute idle for a window nobody can predict. Tradeoff: honest agents on slow links will sometimes miss, so a miss drops you one terrace of trust, not to zero, and the violet mark fades after three clean checks.
